recommendations.title: Phuket: 6 nights is over your max of 5
recommendations.detail: Take the flight Okinawa → Bangkok on Fri Jun 18 (not Jun 17); take the bus Bangkok → Phuket on Tue Jun 22 (not Jun 21). Then: Okinawa 4, Bangkok 4, Phuket 5 nights — all inside your ranges.

recommendations.title: Hanoi: 7 nights, your range is 3–5
recommendations.detail: No neighbouring stop has room for 2 more nights. You meet someone there (Meet Soph Jul 5–10), so the simplest fix is to change the range or add a 2-night stop nearby.

recommendations.title: Bangkok → Phuket bus has no date
recommendations.detail: Places has you moving on Mon Jun 21. Put Jun 21 in the leg's Date column.

recommendations.title: “Misc. Nearby Places” isn't a place the map knows
recommendations.detail: Name the town or island (for example Ubud, Nusa Penida or the Gili Islands) so it shows up on the map and its travel can be checked.

recommendations.title: Jakarta has no legs in or out
recommendations.detail: If you're skipping it, delete the row in Places so the nights add up; otherwise add legs.

recommendations.title: Pick how to get from Fukuoka to Kagoshima: train or rental car
recommendations.detail: Both are in the Legs tab as options. Mark the one you choose as Planned and delete the other.

recommendations.title: Bangkok → Phuket is about 16 hrs by bus
recommendations.detail: That's roughly 901 km. An overnight service saves a day of the trip; a short flight is the other option.

recommendations.title: 1 flight without a price yet
recommendations.detail: The first weekly price check fills these in (needs the SerpApi key on GitHub).

recommendations.title: Your maximum nights add up to exactly 35
recommendations.detail: Every stop at its maximum fills the trip, so there's no spare night: adding a stop means shortening another.
